definitions.label: Accept delivery orders
definitions.description: Allow delivery ordering only after stock, prices and verified coverage checks pass.

definitions.label: Legacy delivery area list
definitions.description: Historical area list retained. Use Delivery coverage locations for current coverage and verify each actual address.

definitions.label: Bookable delivery windows
definitions.description: Available delivery time windows, used by scheduling and rescheduling. Branch opening hours are separate.

definitions.label: Order capacity per delivery window
definitions.description: Maximum active orders for each delivery date/window. Existing branch locking prevents overbooking.

definitions.label: Dispatch route & cost estimates
definitions.description: Internal route-planning rates and stop allowances. Estimates do not change customer delivery fees or bypass route approval checks.

definitions.label: Ajah
definitions.description: Delivery location visibility, boundary and address-confirmation rules. A listed location alone does not confirm an actual delivery address.

definitions.label: Flat customer delivery fee
definitions.description: Fee for each eligible physical delivery order. Service call-outs and internal dispatch cost estimates are separate.

definitions.label: Gas selling price per kg
definitions.description: Selling price per kilogram for new gas quotations. Historic fixed refill prices are separate legacy controls.

definitions.label: Gas order quantities & cylinder sizes
definitions.description: Minimum/maximum quantity, increment, precision and supported cylinder capacities required before gas ordering opens.

definitions.label: Branch opening hours
definitions.description: Customer-facing opening hours for this branch. Delivery windows are configured separately.

definitions.label: Legacy payment integration
definitions.description: Legacy protective switch; it does not enable Paystack. Use Online payments & fees for the Paystack sandbox. Existing protective-disable controls remain available.

definitions.label: Stock valuation method
definitions.description: Value existing stock movements using approved costing rules. Missing acquisition costs keep valuation unavailable; this does not change physical stock.

definitions.label: Customer points adjustment
definitions.description: One immutable, evidenced points adjustment per approved request. This does not transfer money into a wallet.

definitions.label: EasyRewards programme
definitions.description: Current points, discounts, referrals and eligible-offer rules. An activated approved policy and separate technical enablement flags are still required.

definitions.label: Referral eligibility review
definitions.description: Hold, clear or block a referral with evidence and independent review. A shared address alone is not proof of fraud.

definitions.label: Legacy reward earning switch
definitions.description: Historical control retained. Current EasyRewards earning uses the activated EasyRewards programme and technical issuance flag; this switch does not enable that engine.

definitions.label: Legacy spend per reward point
definitions.description: Historical earning rate retained. Configure current earning economics in EasyRewards programme.

definitions.label: Legacy points-to-wallet conversion rate
definitions.description: Historical wallet conversion rate retained. Current EasyRewards uses checkout discounts; this does not enable a points-to-wallet transfer.

definitions.label: Customer retention & win-back rules
definitions.description: Inactivity thresholds and message budgets for retention campaigns. Existing consent, suppression and sending controls still apply.

definitions.label: Cash & bank-transfer wallet limit
definitions.description: Limit approved cash and bank-transfer funding. Bank transfers also check the resulting wallet balance. Card top-up limits are separate under Online payments & fees.

definitions.label: Cash on delivery
definitions.description: Allow cash-on-delivery orders. Payment remains unpaid until the cash is verified.

definitions.label: Settlement bank details
definitions.description: Store governed bank account metadata. This does not configure customer bank-transfer instructions or Paystack credentials.
